description: Draft a concise message with the confirmed update, required action and contact path.
accomplishes: Draft a concise message with the confirmed update, required action and contact path. Avoid exposing other learners’ information or inventing school policy. Mark details needing approval and do not send the message without authorisation.
prompt:
Act as an instructional designer.

Task: Prepare a clear parent communication.

Input context:
- CONFIRMED INFORMATION: [CONFIRMED INFORMATION]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- PURPOSE: [PURPOSE]
- CHANNEL: [CHANNEL]

Draft a concise message with the confirmed update, required action and contact path. Avoid exposing other learners’ information or inventing school policy. Mark details needing approval and do not send the message without authorisation.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Class-project update draft
Explain the upcoming learning activity, confirmed materials and how families can ask questions. Keep individual student performance out of a group message. If a date or cost is unconfirmed, leave it for review rather than guessing. The text should be approved by the responsible teacher; no communication has been sent here.
